original_target.title: Optimal spectral signings of regular graphs

scope_comparison: The finite connected simple cubic graph F in Theorem1.1 has signed adjacency norm>2sqrt2 for every edge signing. That disproves the universal two-sided bound at d3. Its failure to be a Ramanujan base graph does not weaken this counterexample because the local statement does not assume that restriction. A one-sided signing theorem would not suffice.
